name: Gizmon: XT
main_effect:
When you would play this card from your hand, by deleting 1 of your level 4 Digimon, reduce the play cost by 6.
＜Blocker＞ (This Digimon can block in the blocker timing.)
[On Play] Play 1 [Akihiro Kurata] from your trash without paying its cost.
[All Turns] This Digimon can't digivolve.
[On Deletion] You may play 1 [ProtoGizmon] from your trash without paying its cost.
